reason: I'm not driving out to Bexleyheath or Gillingham to collect wheels from some stranger. And I can't tell from words alone whether they'll look good, I need to see photos of the actual set.
objection: New seller, no reviews, no photos of the actual wheels, and I'd have to travel to collect from them. Handing over £300 cash to a stranger for wheels I haven't seen feels risky.
would_change_my_mind: Delivery to my door plus real photos of the exact set, ideally from a seller with some reviews.
